# DraftCal
> AI social media content calendar for creators and brands. Plan a month of content across all platforms in minutes.

## What this site does
DraftCal uses AI to generate a full month of social media content — posts, captions, hashtags, and publishing schedule — for Instagram, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, TikTok, and Facebook. Enter your brand, niche, and tone, and the AI creates a ready-to-use content plan that you can edit and schedule.

## Who it's for
Content creators, social media managers, small business owners, marketing teams, and anyone who needs consistent social media presence without spending hours writing posts.

## Key features
- AI generates 30 days of content in minutes
- Covers Instagram, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, TikTok, Facebook
- Platform-optimised captions with hashtags
- Content calendar view — drag and reschedule
- Brand voice settings — consistent tone every post
- Export to CSV or connect to scheduling tools

## Pricing
Free tier available — generate up to 7 days of content. Pro plan from $9.99/month for unlimited monthly content.
